name: secure-display-workspace
description: Experimental DRM media protection libraries; applications live only in examples/

scripts.build: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/elements/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/document/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && vite build examples/diagnostics && vite build examples/web-components && vite build examples/fairplay-capture && vite build examples/protected-document && vite build examples/protected-page && tsc --noEmit -p examples/auto-secure-element/tsconfig.json && vite build examples/auto-secure-element
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/elements/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/document/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/diagnostics/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/web-components/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/auto-secure-element/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/elements/tsconfig.json && node --test packages/core/test/*.test.mjs packages/elements/test/*.test.mjs packages/document/test/*.test.mjs && node --test tools/test/fps-sdk-local.test.mjs && node --test examples/fairplay-capture/test/*.test.mjs && node --test tools/test/package-test-document.test.mjs && node --test tools/test/network-vite.test.mjs && node --test tools/test/page-fixture.test.mjs examples/protected-page/test/*.test.mjs && node --test experiments/macos-capture-region/test/*.test.mjs && node --test tools/test/dom-element.test.mjs && node --test tools/test/secure-selection.test.mjs && node --test tools/test/react-secure-div.test.mjs
scripts.dev: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && vite examples/diagnostics --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.example:diagnostics: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && vite examples/diagnostics --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.example:elements: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/elements/tsconfig.json && vite examples/web-components --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.example:auto-element: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && vite examples/auto-secure-element --host 0.0.0.0
